anna_sales: Quick heads-up — presales ask from FinRetail (EU regulated). They want EU-only tenancy for POC and a clear answer on sub-processor coverage in France/IE. Can we confirm: 1) no egress to US for data in rest/kv/cache paths, 2) KMS in-region or BYOK option, 3) pricing delta for region-pin + dedicated commit?

marco_se: Short answers: 1) we can route traffic to EU regions only via routing policy + tenant pinning, 2) KMS in-region via cloud KMS available in most EU zones, BYOK requires Private deployment or Dedicated with KMS integration, 3) region-pin on Dedicated is a pricing addon (I can pull numbers).

anna_sales: Do we have an ops-approved statement we can share with the customer? They want plain language for procurement/security.

lisa_security: We can provide a statement but need to confirm subproc list for eu-west-3 (FR) and eu-west-1 (IE). Also need to note any ephemeral metrics/aggregates that might go to control-plane (we typically keep control-plane metadata in GCP/eu control plane for EU accounts).

yvonne_legal: Please route the specific subprocessor and KMS asks to legal@redwood and include the customer's data flow diagram. We need to check contracts for any cross-border transfer clauses before promising zero US egress.

devex_bob: For deal velocity — here's a minimal routing snippet you can show them: ```yaml
routing_policy:
  prefer_regions: [eu-west-3, eu-west-1]
  fallback_regions: [eu-central-1]
  deny_egress_to: [us-east-1, us-west-2]
  tenant_pin: true
```

ops_bot: Subprocessor list (latest): https://intranet.redwood/services/subprocessors?region=eu  :link:  (automated snapshot, timestamps in header)

marco_se: Pricing ballpark: region-pin + reserved Dedicated pool -> +~20-30% on top of base commit depending on GPU mix and standby headroom. BYOK on Dedicated/Private has a one-time integration fee for HSM/KMS connectors — I need PM to confirm exact number.

ian_custsuccess: For the POC, recommend: 1) share the ops snippet + subproc snapshot, 2) request the customer's infra/data flow, 3) offer a 30-day dedicated eval with limited ingress/egress SLAs so legal can validate. I'll own the handoff.

anna_sales: Thanks all. Action items: @marco_se pull formal quote and confirm integration fee, @lisa_security prepare a short plain-language security statement for EU-only tenancy, @yvonne_legal review cross-border clause, @devex_bob can you attach the POC runbook? I'll send this bundle to the customer tonight. :thumbsup:

devex_bob: attaching runbook now — link: https://intranet.redwood/playbooks/poc-eu-pin (contains steps, expected logs, test prompts, rollback checklist).

marco_se: On it — I'll have the quote + cost breakdown by EOD UTC.

lisa_security: Drafted the one-pager, sending to @yvonne_legal for review, will attach when cleared.

yvonne_legal: Reviewing now, will flag any contract language edits. If we need a Data Processing Amendment tweak, flag procurement early.

anna_sales: Perfect. If anyone sees anything that blocks an explicit "no-US-egress" statement, call it out here.

marco_se: small caveat: control-plane telemetry for hosted accounts may touch non-customer regions for telemetry ingestion unless we enable private control plane — I'll call this out in the quote as an optional add-on.

anna_sales: Acknowledged. Will include that nuance in the customer email.

ian_custsuccess: I'll schedule a short call with the customer tomorrow to walk the bundle.

anna_sales: Great — thanks team.
